attributes.title: DropLab
attributes.subtitle: A collaborative release studio that extracts facts from messy media, interprets rights with AI, generates campaign variants, and keeps every human decision auditable.

cardInfo.name: Factory Trial 02 — DropLab
cardInfo.summary: A culturally current software-factory proposal combining mixed-media extraction, AI interpretation and generation, multi-user approvals, provenance, and catalog reuse.
cardInfo.notes: Proposed 2026-07-21. The fictional test release combines music, limited apparel, short film, guest collaborators, sample clearance, and four publishing channels. Pass targets are hypotheses to measure during the run.
